title: Qwen Image 2.1 guided edit
description: Local guided edit using an edit target, one to three reference images and a text instruction. Additional reference binding is implemented; multi-reference visual fidelity is not yet qualified. A selected-element fabric-badge integration produced a real PNG on the qualified RTX 4090 worker; perspective and identity fidelity remain model-dependent.

evidence: Converted from the installed ComfyUI workflow with src/workflow/ui-to-api.ts against the live ComfyUI 0.37.0 object_info inventory after omitting editor-only ImageCompare node 472 and its two display links. Installed source SHA-256: d6dd8695469c20ca5e77b4bddf981b898ee0e034f0cfc5840c86f15b812ca081.

The graph, node inventory, two-image binding, model filenames and upstream model digests are source-mapped. A real ComfyField submission imported an edited 1024x1024 PNG with PostgreSQL provenance on 2026-10-18; quality, memory use and an offline run remain unqualified. Perceptual edit quality on arbitrary footage is not proven.
